Two separate disposable bare remotes rejected push without explicit authorization, then received the corresponding source and tracker refs with authorization. The mandate does not establish a safe exemption policy for uninspectable content, so the public helpers fail closed rather than silently weakening the privacy boundary. This is not a claim of universal source-file support.
